Tamil Nadu Investment Agency Sacks Staff Over Data Leak Allegations

Fifteen contract employees of Guidance Tamil Nadu, the state's investment promotion agency, have been terminated following allegations that confidential information about prospective industrial investments was leaked to officials in Andhra Pradesh. Three employees have reportedly joined an agency in Andhra Pradesh.
